data.body: **P3 — Include structurally typed factories in this guard.** This early return exempts the Insight package because `workflowInsight` returns a structural `{ createPlugin(...) }` type and its non-test sources never name `DurableInstrumentationPluginFactory`. Its peer range can therefore regress to core 2.x while this suite passes, although core 2.x never invokes that factory and Insight emits nothing. Annotate the Insight factory with the contract type and assert that Insight is discovered, or otherwise make package discovery authoritative.
